svg.title: Time of one call for NCP 2 and other systems
svg.desc: Small multiples: rows for Rust and Python, columns for N of 0, 127, 1788, and 87381 spikes. Each panel shows a dot for the call time of each arm on a log scale, with a line for the range of the block medians. Values are in summary.md.
